scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Independent arclength-uniform point pairs on a compact two-cusp plane arc with unique diametral cusp pair and nonzero inward cubic coefficients; complete one-arch cycloid as a proven example.
limitations: A unique diametral endpoint pair is a necessary global hypothesis.
No full chord-distance distribution, rate of convergence, or uniform deformations are established.
The absolute cusp-curvature product, not individual curvatures, is encoded by the leading tail at fixed arc length.
Independent priority and mathematical audits are not performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic Euclidean chord bound plus uniform asymptotic cusp scaling and Dirichlet simplex integration; numerical checks supplement but do not certify infinite claims.

title: Cuspidal curvature and the four-thirds rare-diameter law for cycloidal arches
